༄༅/ /sman bla longs spyod rdzogs sku'i gtso 'khor lnga'i sgrub thabs dngos grub bang mdzod bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// sman bla longs spyod rdzogs sku'i gtso 'khor lnga'i sgrub thabs dngos grub bang mdzod bzhugs so//

oṃ swa sti// gang zhig lha lam sgrib bral gsal mdangs can// thun mtshams li khris bla gos bgos bzhin du// rmongs 'khrul log pa'i lam las 'dren mkhas pa'i// sangs rgyas sman gyi bla ma spyi bos mchod// khyod gsung dam chos bdud rtsi ro brgya pa// pa sangs slob mas ma 'thung bdud rtsi'i bcud// bcud 'chang dharma swa mi'i mtshan nas brgyud// brgyud pa'i bla ma mchog rnams rgyal gyur cig /dkyil 'khor cha rdzogs g.yu thog mgon la sogs// dam chos bsil zer 'gyed pa'i mgon de kun// deng dus nub ri'i khri la gzims gyur nas// lo mang lon zhing 'di lugs gso byed dang*// de tshe dam chos a ti rdzogs pa che'i// nyams len sman spyad zung 'brel gnas mchis kyang*| |deng dus chu shing rul ba lta bu yi// sman pa mang pos nyams len rgyang bsrings nas// lag len 'khyog pos lus can slur mthong nas// de dag ma bzod dang ba'i blo gros kyis// rnam dpyod spobs pa'i shing rtas myur drangs nas// bla ma longs spyod rdzogs pa'i skur sgrub pa// yi ge'i lam du 'khyol gyi shes ldan tsho// mos blo'i spobs pa bskyed la 'di longs shig /'dir 'jug pa'i gang zag gis gnas dben par rdul tshon sogs kyi pad+ma 'dab ma bzhi/ lte ba mu khyud dang bcas pa bris pa'i mthar mchod pa ci 'byor ba bshams/ dkar gtor sman sna dang 'bru snas brgyan pa dang*/ zhang blon sogs sman srung rnams la gtor ma zur gsum sha khrag gis brgyan pa bshams/ rdo rje/ dril bu/ ḍā ma ru/ nang mchod rnams kyang nyer bsdogs bya/ tshogs kyi yo byad rnams 'du byas la/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed tshad med bzhi sngon du 'gro bas/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pad zla'i gdan la rang nyid sangs rgyas sman gyi bla sku mdog baiḍūr+ya ltar 'tsher ba/ mtshan dang dpe byad kyi dpal mnga' ba/ phyag g.yas sa gnon dang g.yon mnyam bzhag mdzad pa/

chos gos gsum dang ldan pa zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa'i mdun du/ pad+ma 'dab ma bzhi pa'i lte bar paṃ las pad+ma dkar po dang*/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nya gang ba'i gdan la/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad yongs su 'dus pa'i ngo bo sangs rgyas sman gyi bla baiḍūr+ya'i 'od kyi rgyal po sku mdog nam mkha' g.ya' dag pa lta bu ut+pal ltar spyan dkyus ring ba'i spyan zur 'gro ba'i gdul bya la phyogs bcur gzigs pa/ mthon ka'i dbu skra spyi bor bcings pa'i phyed sil bur rgyab tu phyogs pa/ thor cog gi rtse mor nor bu rin po che dang*/ g.yas g.yon du nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor gyis spras pa/ 'gro ba thams cad kyi dbul phong dang*/ tsha grang gi nad las skyob pa'i rin chen sna tshogs kyi dbu rgyan la mi bskyod pa gtso bor gyur pa'i rigs lngas spras pa| phyag g.yas mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgyas 'dab ma dang bcas pa'i a ru ra rnam par rgyal ba dang*/ g.yon mnyam bzhag gis sman gyi bdud rtsis gang ba'i lhung bzed bsnams pa/ dar dkar po dang dmar pos stod g.yogs dang smad g.yogs 'chang ba/ zhabs rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ sku mtshan dang dpe byad gyis brgyan pa/ gsung dbyangs yan lag drug cu dang ldan zhing thugs ting nge 'dzin brgya phrag du mas snyoms par zhugs pa/ de la gso rig brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyis bskor nas bzhugs pa/ mdun gyi 'dab ma la sman gyi lha mo dkar mo phyag gnyis rin chen pi wang bsgyur ba/ g.yas su lha mo ser mo phyag gnyis bya rgod kyi rkang gling bsgyur ba/ rgyab tu lha mo dmar mo phyag gnyis mi rkang gi gling bu 'bud pa/ g.yon du lha mo ljang gu phyag gnyis dngul dkar gyi me long 'dzin pa/ bzhi ka'ang bcu drug lon pa'i na tshod can skra sil bur grol ba/ me tog dang dar dang rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/

zhabs phyed skyil gyis bcom ldan 'das la 'dud pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs pa/ mu khyud la sman gyi srung ma zhang blon chen po dang*/ drang srong lha klu gza' skar rgyal po btsan bdud ging gi tshogs til gyi gang bu ltar gang ba rnams gtso bo'i phyogs su thal mo sbyar te 'khod pa/ dbus kyi gtso 'khor lnga'i gnas gsum gyi yi ge gsum dang*/ dregs byed rnams kyi snying khar rang rang gi sa bon las 'od 'phros pas ye shes pa rnams rang bzhin chos kyi dbyings nas spyan drangs te rang rang gi dam tshig pa dang dbyer med du gyur/ 'jig rten pa rnams kyang phyogs thams cad nas 'dus te so so'i rten la thim par gyur/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sa ma ya dzaḥtiṣ+ṭha lhan/ bde chen dbus kyi bcom ldan 'das la mi bskyod pa dang lha mo bzhi la sangs rgyas sman gyi bla re res dbu brgyan/ 'jig rten pa thams cad la rdo rje rtse dgu pa re res rgyas btab par gyur par mos te/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ de bzhin du/ shapada'i bar sbyar bas mchod/ gtor ma bsangs sbyangs/ a kā ro gsum gyis byin brlabs/ rtsa sngags 'jug tu/ i daṃ ba ling+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ gsum dang*/ gtor ma bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen po 'di/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das sman gyi bla baiḍūr+ya 'od kyi rgyal po/ 'khor rigs bzhi'i lha mo sman gyi srung ma mched bzhi dang bcas pa la 'bul lo// bzhes nas bdag dang sems can thams cad gnas skabs rlung mkhris bad kan 'dus pa'i nad tsha grang gi zug rngu thams cad zhi ba dang*/ mthar thug sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang rin po che thob par mdzad du gsol/ zhes dang*/ 'jig rten pa rnams la/ oṃ lo ka pā la sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ ba ling+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ gsum dang*/ gtor ma bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen po 'di zhang blon chen po drang srong lha klu gza' skar rgyal po btsan bdud ging shan pho nya bka' sdod dregs pa'i srung ma 'khor dang bcas pas gtor ma 'di tshim zhing dgyes par bzhes la ru nga dang phrag dog ko long gdug sems zhi ste/

zhi ba dul ba byang chub kyi sems dang ldan pas bdag gi gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi bar chad dang mi mthun pa'i phyogs ris ngan pa thams cad zhi bar mdzod cig /legs pa brgya dang sprod cig /nyes pa stong dang snol cig /bsam pa'i don sgrubs shig /bdag gi tshe dang bsod nams snyan grags mnga' thang longs spyod dpal dang 'byor pa thams cad zla ba yar kyi ngo'am dbyar dus kyi mtsho ltar gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas par mdzod cig /de nas bstod pa ni/ rdor dril 'dzin pas 'di skad do// chos dbyings rnam dag 'dus ma byas yin yang*// sprul pa'i cho 'phrul snang brnyan sman gyi bla| |dus gsum bde gshegs kun gyi ngo bo nyid// baiḍūr+ya yi 'od la phyag 'tshal lo// sku mdog sngon po nam mkha' sgrib bral ltar// mtshan dpe'i dpal 'bar dar dang rin chen brgyan| |skra mchog bung ba phyed bcings rgyab du grol// phyag gnyis mchog sbyin mnyam bzhag mdzad phyag 'tshal// khyod gsung mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lo yi// dbyangs kyi nga ro drug cu'i bye brag las// drang nges chos kun lhug par rab bstan nas// 'gro ba'i zug sel skyabs mchog la phyag 'tshal// thugs kyi gsang ba dpag yas zab gsal che// rgya mtsho che ltar gting mtha' rnyog pa bral// mi zad ting 'dzin du mar dbang bsgyur ba'i// nges don ston mdzad khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// khyod gsung dam chos bdud rtsi'i rgyun bzang po// gang gi blo gros bum par legs bkang nas// thar 'dod yongs la legs lam ston mdzad pa// brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// phyogs bzhi rigs bzhi'i sman srung lha mo bzhi// dkar ser dmar ljang rin chen dar gyis brgyan// rang rang rtags kyi phyag mtshan dang bcas te// gtso la 'dud tshul bzhugs la phyag 'tshal bstod// phyi rol zhang blon drang srong gza' skar dang*// lha klu rgyal btsan ging shan dregs byed tshogs// bcom ldan 'das la 'dud tshul thal sbyar bzhugs// sman gyi srung ma dregs byed tshogs la bstod// ces bstod|

bzlas pa ni/ rang gi thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su hūm̐ gi mthar rtsa sngags kyis bskor ba/ mdun bskyed kyi bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs tsit+ta dmar po pad+ma rā ga'i mdog ltar zur drug pa de dag gi zur drug las 'od zer re re'i sna la thub pa drug 'phros pas/ 'gro ba rigs drug gi zug rngu ma rig pa'i tshogs sel ba/ de'i dbus su tsa ti li ka shel gyi sbu gu can shel dkar gyi ka ba btsugs pa lta bu las 'od zer brgya phrag du ma 'phros pas zhi ba dang khro bo dam pa rigs brgya 'phro ba/ de'i rtsa sbug tu pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga sgreng thabs su bzhugs pa'i yar gyi rwa lnga la rigs lnga yab yum sbyor ba mdzad nas bzhugs shing mar gyi rwa lnga la khrag 'thung rigs lnga yab yum 'khril sbyor du bzhugs pa/ rdo rje'i lte bar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su hūm̐ sngon po baiḍūr+ya lta bu'i mthar rtsa sngags kyis bskor bar gyur/ lha mo bzhi'i thugs kar zla ba'i gdan re re'i dbus su mdun nas g.yas skor du ha ri ni sa dang*/ 'jig rten pa rnams kyi snying khar rang rang gi sa bon gyis mtshan par gyur par dmigs te/ na mo bha ga wa te gu ru baiḍūr+ya pra bha rā dzā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ ar+ha te samyak+saṃ bud+dhā ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ bhai ṣa dz+ye bhai ṣa dz+ye ma hā bhai ṣa dz+ye bhai ṣa dz+ye rā' dzā sa mud+ga te ha ri ni sa ma hā sarba sid+dhi pha la hoḥ zhes ci mang bzla'o// skabs skabs su bzlas pas skyo na brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs pa ni/ dpag yas bsod nams tshogs gnyis las 'khrungs shing*// mtshan dpe'i dpal 'bar baiḍūr+ya yi mdog /mchog sbyin mnyam bzhag phyag rgyas 'gro ba skyob// sangs rgyas sman gyi bla mar gsol ba 'debs// de'i gsung chos kun sdud dang zhu ba dang*// legs par ston sogs chos kyi mdzod 'dzin pa// yid las skyes dang rig pa'i ye shes mtshan// drang srong rnam gnyis zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// rgyun shes nab so skyes dang thang la 'bar// rkang gnyis spyod dang 'gro skyong me bzhin 'jug

/lug lag rgya skyegs sna dang zla ba'i chog /lan tsha'i mchog gi zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// dpal ldan phreng ba dpal ldan phun tshogs dang*// bshol 'gro skye dang snyigs ma'i snying po dang*// zla ba'i 'od zer dge slong kun dga' bo// 'tsho byed gzhon nu'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// klu sgrub snying po dpal ldan dga' ba'i mtshan// zla ba mngon dga' bai ro tsa na dang*// khri srong lde'u btsan grwa pa mngon par shes// dbus pa dar grags zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// dge slong dkon skyabs g.yu thog yon tan mgon// ye shes bzang dang 'bo se kun tu dga'// 'dzam gling mgon dang dwags po tsan+d+ra dang*// 'tsho mdzad rgyal po'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// tsha lung pa dang g.yu thog mgon po dang*// ban mo ga ga gzhon nu ye shes zhabs// de sras brang ti 'jam dpal rgyal mtshan dang*// g.yu thog nyi ma'i mgon la gsol ba 'debs// gzi brjid 'bar dang rje ston bzung ba dang*// zhang ston zhig po lha rje dge ba 'bum// sman mo che dang rat+na'i mtshan can dang*// bsod nams dbang po'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// rnal 'byor chen po ri khrod zhig po dang*// dkon mchog rgyal mtshan mnyam nyid rdo rje'i zhabs// pad+ma skyabs dang dkon mchog dpal bzang rje// byams pa'i mtshan can zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// paṇa chen mgon dpal 'gro don legs bzang dang*// sman bla don grub rje btsun nor bu rgyas// rig 'dzin chos grags phrin las rnam par rgyal// phrin las bzang po bcas la gsol ba 'debs// don grub chos rgyal bstan pa'i nyin byed dbang*// nges legs bstan 'dzin tshe dbang kun khyab dpal// chos dpal bzang po chos kyi rgyal mtshan dang*// chos kyi blo gros chos nyid nor bu sogs// brgyud pa'i bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ chos grags man chad bla brgyud kha bskangs ba'o// mchan// g.yu thog mgon khyod slar yang byang phyogs 'dir// dge slong tshul bzung thos bsam sgron me sbar// 'gro ba kun gyi skyabs gcig thugs rje can// mnyam nyid rdo rje'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// khyod gsung chos mdzod 'dzin pa'i thugs sras bzhi// de las 'ongs pa'i slob rgyud bhan+dha'i phreng*// ma chad ma nyams legs ston gser gyi zam// rgyud 'dzin sman pa'i tshogs la gsol ba 'debs// lha mo mched bzhi gnod sbyin zhang blon sogs// gso rig rgyud dang sman gyi srung ma'i tshogs// ye shes 'jig rten tshul 'dzin sprul 'khor bcas// bka' srung dregs byed tshogs la gsol ba 'debs// de ltar gsol ba btab pa'i byin rlabs kyis// bdag ni skye ba tshe rabs thams cad du// gso dpyad rig pa'i gnas la mkhas pa dang*// drang srong rgyud pa zin pa byin gyis rlobs// nad pas sman pa thos sam mthong ba'i tshe// sman gyi nags su bslebs pa ji bzhin du// rlung mkhris bad kan 'dus pa tsha grang nad// rang rang shugs kyis grol bar byin gyis rlobs// sman pas nad par brtag dpyad byas pa'i tshe// drang srong 'khor bcas thugs rje'i cho 'phrul gyis// mngon shes bzhin rig me long phyis pa bzhin// nad kyi mtshan nyid mthong bar byin gyis rlobs| |sman pas kha dmar gdag tshe g.yu 'brug gi// skad la rma bya spro ltar nad pa bde// sman gyi dri la sbrul gyis ma ki ta'i// dri la 'bros ltar nad kyi grong khyer tshogs// skad cig nyid la 'joms par byin gyis rlobs// tsha bsil sbyor ba bsil drod rtar skyon nas// nad pa'i ljags kyi dbang po dang 'phrad tshe// ro drug nus brgyad ldan pa'i stobs 'phel te// nad kyi dgra dpung zhig par byin gyis rlobs// mgul mgrin pho bar sleb tshe me drod kyis// zhu rjes mngar skyur kha ba'i tshul byung bas// rlung khris bad kan 'phel zad 'khrugs la sogs//

nad kyi g.yul ngo bzlog par byin gyis rlobs// sman rnams zhu rjes nad rjes chod pa dang*// lus zungs stobs 'phel tshe yi bar chad zhi// bsam pa'i don kun chos bzhin 'grub pa dang*| |'jig med rdo rje'i lus mchog thob gyur cig /sems can thams cad ngan song gsum sogs kyi// sdug bsngal me rlabs zhi nas chos bsgrubs te// thos bsam sgom pa'i bya ba la sbyangs nas// sman gyi rgyal po'i go 'phang thob gyur cig /sangs rgyas sman gyi bla ma'i thugs rje dang*// drang srong rig 'dzin lha dbang mthu rtsal dang*// chos dbyings rnam par dag pa'i bden tshig gis// smon lam myur du 'grub pa'i rgyur gyur cig /ces gsol 'debs smon lam bya bzlas pa la 'bad do// ༈ /de nas tshogs kyi yo byad rnams bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las thod pa'i sgyed pu gsum gyi steng du/ thod pa phyi dkar la nang dmar ba yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ hūm̐ oṃ trāṃ aṃ khaṃ las dri chen dri chu rak+ta byang sems klad pa rnams sa bon gyis mtshan pa'i steng du/ hūm̐ lāṃ māṃ bāṃ tāṃ las mi dang ba glang dang khyi dang glang po che dang go ra rnams kyi sha rang rang gi sa bon gyis mtshan pa zla ba'i kha gcod yi ge gsum gyis rgyas btab pa/ rlung g.yos me sbar thod pa dros rdzas khol ba'i rlangs pa yi ge gsum la phog /de las 'od 'phros phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs 'od zer gyi rnam par bsdus/ yi ge gsum la thim zhing zla ba'i kha gcod yi ge gsum dang bcas pa 'od du zhu ba rdzas so so sa bon dang bcas pa yongs su gyur pa las bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha hoḥhrīḥ zhes gsum brjod/ tshogs phud gtor ma gnyis la bran/ hūm̐ */ chos dbyings rnam dag bde gshegs pho brang nas// sman bla longs spyod rdzogs sku gshegs su gsol// sman zhal bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen po yi// ga ṇa tsakra'i longs spyod mchog 'bul gyi// bzhes nas dbang dang dngos grub stsal du gsol// ka dag 'gyur med lhun grub pho brang nas// yid skyes rig pa'i ye shes gnas 'dir gshegs// sman zhal bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen po yi// ga ṇa tsakra'i longs spyod mchog 'bul gyi// bzhes nas dbang dang dngos grub stsal du gsol// bde chen 'og min mi 'gyur gzhal yas nas// rgyun shes la sogs rtsa brgyud bla ma la// sman zhal bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen po yi// ga ṇa tsakra'i longs spyod mchog 'bul gyi// bzhes nas dbang dang dngos grub stsal du gsol// bden gnyis mtha' bral zung 'jug khang bzang nas// mkhas grub g.yu thog yon tan mgon po la// sman zhal bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen po yi// ga ṇa tsakra'i longs spyod mchog 'bul gyi// bzhes nas dbang dang dngos grub stsal du gsol// klong chen rig pa rang grol pho brang nas// rdzogs chen rnal 'byor mnyam nyid badz+ra la// sman zhal bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen po yi// ga ṇa tsakra'i longs spyod mchog 'bul gyi// bzhes nas dbang dang dngos grub stsal du gsol// gar bzhugs lta na sdug gi grong khyer nas// sman srung rigs bzhi lha mo mched bzhi la// sman zhal bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen po yi// ga ṇa tsakra'i longs spyod 'di 'bul gyi// bzhes nas dbang dang dngos grub stsal du gsol// phyogs bcu nam mkha' yangs pa'i dkyil 'khor nas// zhang blon la sogs dregs pa 'khor bcas la// sman zhal bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen po yi// ga ṇa tsakra'i longs spyod 'di 'bul gyi// bzhes nas dbang dang dngos grub stsal du gsol// bskang ba ni/

hūm̐ */ sman gyi grong khyer gzhal yas chen po 'dir// phyi nang mchod sprin rgya mtsho bskyil ba dang*// ye shes tshogs kyi 'khor lo dpag med kyis// bud+dha bde bar gshegs pa'i thugs dam bskang*// sman phud rin chen dar dang ja khur dang*// phun sum tshogs pa'i 'dod yon kun bsdus pa// kun tu bzang po'i mchod pa'i bye brag gis// brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyi thugs dam bskang*// tsha grang nad sel bzang drug sman sna sogs// ro nus ldan pa'i sman sna mang po dang*// dbang po sna lnga rin chen zas nor gyis// sman srung lha mo mched bzhi thugs dam bskang*// sha khrag rus pa nang rol rnam pa lnga// don snying klad pa rkang dang khu ba dang*// ba ling sha khrag rgyan ldan gtor chen gyis// zhang blon la sogs dregs tshogs thugs dam skang*// bskangs gyur dngos grub dam pa dus 'dir stsol// ces bskangs/ bshags pa ni/ bdag cag ma rig du ma'i dbang gyur pas// sku gsung thugs dang rtsa ba yan lag gi// dam tshig nyams shing dus su ma bshags pa// 'gal 'khrul log par gyur pa ci mchis pa// rtsa 'grel rgyud gzhung ma thos ma bskang dang*// gdams ldan bla ma ma bsten rkun chos dang*// mkhas grub slob dpon ma bsten rang bzor gyur// man ngag lag len 'chug cing nor ba dang*// rgyal ba'i dgongs pa ma rtogs 'khrul par spyad// de sogs bka' 'grel gzhung dang ci 'gal ba// chos bdag sangs rgyas drung du mthol lo bshags// mkhyen ldan khyod kyis cis kyang bzod par rigs// rlung mkhris bad kan 'dus pa'i tsha grang nad// rang rang gnyen po'i sman rnams nor ba dang*// ro nus zhus rjes log par sdeb pa dang*// kha cig sbyor sde chad lhag 'khrul pa dang*// rang gis phan sems mos blo cher bskyed nas// nad kyi gnyen por sman rnams legs byin yang*// sngon las dbang gis de dag srog dor tshe// bdag la blo gtad byas kyang ma skyob pa'i// nyes sdig rmongs pa'i 'khrul pa ci mchis dang*// sman 'ga'i ngo bo ma rtogs nor ba sogs// 'khrul bcas nongs pa bdag yid mchis pa kun// sman srung lha mo bzhi la mthol lo bshags// bzod par bzhes la dngos grub stsal du gsol// gdams pa'i man ngag zab khyad ldan pa 'ga'// chig brgyud yin yang de las 'gal ba dang*// dam med 'ga' la man ngag bstan pa dang*| |chom kun zog po dam log 'ga' zhig la// man ngag sbas kyang 'ga' zhig shor srid cing*// thabs kyis rku dang gzhogs slong byed pa dang*// slob dpon gsod cing rang chen byed pa dang*// don med khyad du gsod pa'i bdud sprul 'gas// slob mar rdzus la gdams pa bstan pa sogs// rang blo 'khrul pa tshad mar bzung byas nas| |zhang blon dregs byed thugs dang 'gal ba kun// mthol zhing bshags so bzod par bzhes nas kyang*// bdag gi bar chad phyogs rnams zhi ba dang*// bsam don chos bzhin 'grub pa'i phrin las mdzod// ces dang yig brgya brjod/

de nas tshogs la ci dgar longs spyad pa'i lhag ma bsdus la bdud rtsi bran te/ a kā ro gsum gyi byin gyis brlabs/ bde gshegs chos srung zhang blon dregs pa'i tshogs| |pho nya 'bum phrag khro bo bran g.yog dang*// bka' sdod sde brgyad 'byung po lhag ma'i bdag /ma lus 'khor bcas 'dir gshegs lhag ma longs// bcol ba'i las sgrubs chos kyi bya ra mdzod// bar chad rkyen dang mtha' yi dmag dpung zlog /phrin las rnam bzhi lhun gyis 'grub par mdzod// ces lhag ma gtsang sar 'bul/ de nas thugs dam bskul ba ni/ rang bzhin dag pa chos dbyings pho brang nas// bud+dha rigs kyi sangs rgyas thugs dam bskul// phyogs bzhi pad+ma zla ba'i gdan steng nas// sman srung lha mo mched bzhi'i thugs dam bskul// nam mkha' stong la dbang sgyur pho brang nas// zhang blon dregs byed tshogs kyi thugs dam bskul// mchod sbyin gtor ma dgyes bzhin gsol nas kyang*// bdag gi las kyi 'bras bu mchis par mdzod| |ces bskul/ chad mdo ni/ bh+yoḥ sngon tshe sman gyi yul ljongs nags tshal du// ston pa sangs rgyas sman gyi bla chen pos// gso rig rgyud rgyal mang du gsung ba'i tshe// zhang blon la sogs dregs byed 'khor bcas kyis// rang rang mthu rtsal che ba bstan nas kyang*// khas blangs dam bca' ji bzhin de dgongs la// 'dir gshegs dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i gtor ma longs| |rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod// de 'og bar gyi bskal pa'i dbus ma la// chos rgyal chen po khri srong lde'u btsan gyis// bod 'dir gso rig rgyas par mdzad pa'i tshe// dregs pa sde brgyad mthu rtsal ldan rnams kyis// rang rang mthu rtsal che ba bstan nas kyang*// khas blangs dam bca' ji bzhin de dgongs la// 'dir gshegs dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i gtor ma longs// rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod// de 'og da lta bskal pa'i tha ma la// bdag sogs gso rig brgyud pa 'dzin rnams kyis// bka' grol man ngag nyams su blang ba'i tshe// sman srung lha mo dregs byed tshogs rnams kyis// rang rang mthu rtsal che ba bstan nas kyang*// khas blangs dam bca' ji bzhin de dgongs la// 'dir gshegs dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i gtor ma longs// rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod// de nas brtan ma skyong ba ni/

gong gi dmar gtor de phyir bteg chab bran la| bh+yoḥ sman gyi srung ma lha mo mched bzhi dang*// zhang blon chen po rdo rje bdud 'dul dang*// lha klu btsan bdud ging shan gza' skar tshogs// brtan ma bcu gnyis yang skyong 'khor dang bcas| |'dir byon sngon gyi dam tshig nyer dgongs te// sha khrag brgyan gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la// bar chad rkyen dang mi mthun gnod pa'i tshogs// mtha' yi dmag dpung g.yul ngo zlog pa dang*// bsam don 'bad med chos bzhin 'grub par mdzod// ces gtor ma gtsang sar 'bul/ de nas mdun bskyed kyi lha la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ nas/ shapada'i bar gyis mchod/ sman gyi bla ma thugs rje'i gter// sman srung rigs kyi lha mo bzhi// zhang blon la sogs dregs pa'i tshogs// 'khor dang bcas la bstod par bgyi// zhes bstod/ bdag gis legs byas dge ba 'dis mtshon te// nad rigs mi mthun phyogs kun rab zhi ste// 'bad med bsam pa'i don kun 'grub pa dang*// gtso bo khyod bzhin byang chub reg gyur cig |ces smon lam btab bo// oṃ khyod kyis sems can don kun mdzod// rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol// sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang*// slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol| |oṃ badz+ra muḥ ye shes pa rnams rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs// dam tshig pa rnams rang nyid la thim// 'jig rten pa rnams kyang rang rang gnas su gshegs par gyur par bsam| bkra shis dang bsngo smon rnams rgyas bsdus skabs dang sbyar la bya'o// 'dir smras pa/ blo gros lang tsho dar ba'i shes 'chang ba// rnam dag thos pa mchog gi rgyan gyis mdzes// rnam dpyod shes rab mchog gis blta byed mkhan// zug sel rnam pa mchog khyod dgyes phyir 'bul/ /sngon chad 'di 'dra grags par ma gyur pa'i// rig gnas gsar bu zhig la 'di sman phyir// shes ldan kun gyi dgongs rgyan 'di las ci// deng dus gso dpyad mdzad pa phal cher 'gas// rnam grangs lag len long ba'i kha zas bzhin/

/rang nyid 'tsho tsam de las gzhan legs su/ /nad sel byang chub sgrub pa'i thabs 'di kun/ /long bas g.yang sar lam sna byas srid na/ /rang phung gzhan la mi phan de dang mtshungs// de phyir sman dpyad bla sgrub mchog 'di ni// kho bos go slar phye ba 'di yin no// bdag gis gso dpyad slob dpon ma bsten cing*// lag len dag kyang mkhas par ma sbyangs kyang*// yan lag brgyad dang rgyud bzhi la sogs la// cung zad bltas pas don 'ga' khong du chud// sngon dus smon lam bzang po'i mthu btsan pas// sbyor ba che ba 'ga' zhig bdag gis rtogs// de phyir lhag bsam dag pas 'di bskrun to// longs sku'i sgrub thabs mchog 'di ni// rin chen ril nag rab gnas kyi// dus su sgrub pa 'di byas na// shin tu zab phyir bris pa yin// rgyun 'khyer nyams len byas kyang mchog /ril nag che chung gang byed kyang*// sbyor tshe sgrub pa 'di bya zhing*// tshogs 'khor rtag tu gtong ba gces// mkhas pa kun gyi rgyan 'di yang*// shes ldan yongs kyis thugs la zhog /ces pa bla ma longs sku'i sgrub thabs 'di// rin chen grangs sbyor ril nag che 'bring chung ngu'i cha lag tu slob dpon kong sman dkon mchog rgyal mtshan gyis yang nas yang du bskul ba'i ngor/ bla sgrub rdzogs pa chen po a ti yo ga dang 'brel ba ste/ rig gnas 'di la nges pa cung zad rnyed pa'i dge slong chos smra ba dharma kīrtis chu glang sa ga zla ba'i dga' ba dang po la rme shod phu'i sgar du sbyar ba'o// sgo byang rig pa'i nga ro 'dul ba mdo dang mngon pa gsang sngags sde snod pha rol son| |sgra dang tshad ma bzo dang gso ba nang don rig gnas lnga// sdeb sbyor mngon brjod snyan ngag zlos gar tshig rgyan phra mo ste// rig gnas che chung bcu phrag dang ni dkar nag rtsis lugs dang*// dbyangs 'char la sogs rnyed dka'i rig pa sna tshogs bdag gis shes// 'gran par 'dod pa yod na tshur byon rtsod pa mdzod cig dang*// bdag gis tshad ma rnam bzhis legs par gtan la 'bebs par spro// lta ba bla med rnam dag rtogs pa'ang dus 'dir kho bo tsam// zhes pa'i yi ge 'bri gung dge slong gnas lnga rig pa chos kyi grags pa phrin las rnam par rgyal ba'i sde zhes bya bas bris pa'o//
